task: Find the tech specs of the MacBook Pro 16-inch introduced in November 2023.
agent_final_answer:
Technical Specifications for the MacBook Pro (16-inch, Nov 2023):

Official Source: Apple Support (https://support.apple.com/en-us/117737)
Model: MacBook Pro (16-inch, Nov 2023)
Year introduced: 2023

1. Finishes
- Space Black
- Silver

2. Chips & Processors
- Apple M3 Pro chip:
  • 12-core CPU with 6 performance cores and 6 efficiency cores
  • 18-core GPU
  • Hardware-accelerated ray tracing
  • 16-core Neural Engine
  • 150GB/s memory bandwidth
  • Media Engine: Hardware-accelerated H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and ProRes RAW; video decode engine; video encode engine; ProRes encode and decode engine; AV1 decode
  • Configurable to M3 Max (14-core CPU / 30-core GPU or 16-core CPU / 40-core GPU)

- Apple M3 Max chip:
  • 14-core CPU with 10 performance cores and 4 efficiency cores, OR 16-core CPU with 12 performance cores and 4 efficiency cores
  • 30-core GPU (with 14-core CPU) or 40-core GPU (with 16-core CPU)
  • Hardware-accelerated ray tracing
  • 16-core Neural Engine
  • Memory Bandwidth: 300GB/s (14-core CPU) or 400GB/s (16-core CPU)
  • Media Engine: Hardware-accelerated H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and ProRes RAW; video decode engine; two video encode engines; two ProRes encode and decode engines; AV1 decode

3. Display
- Liquid Retina XDR display
- 16.2-inch (diagonal) Liquid Retina XDR display (3456-by-2234 native resolution at 254 pixels per inch)
- 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio
- XDR brightness: 1000 nits sustained full-screen, 1600 nits peak (HDR content only)
- SDR brightness: 600 nits
- 1 billion colors, Wide color (P3), True Tone technology
- ProMotion technology for adaptive refresh rates up to 120Hz
- Fixed refresh rates: 47.95Hz, 48.00Hz, 50.00Hz, 59.94Hz, 60.00Hz

4. Unified Memory
- M3 Pro: 18GB unified memory (configurable to 36GB)
- M3 Max: 36GB unified memory (configurable to 48GB, 64GB, 96GB, or 128GB depending on CPU configuration)

5. Storage
- M3 Pro: 512GB SSD (configurable to 1TB, 2TB, or 4TB)
- M3 Max: 1TB SSD (configurable to 2TB, 4TB, or 8TB)

6. Battery and Power
- Up to 22 hours Apple TV app movie playback
- Up to 15 hours wireless web
- 100-watt-hour lithium-polymer battery
- 140W USB-C Power Adapter
- USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable
- Fast-charge capable with included 140W USB-C Power Adapter

7. Ports and Expansion
- SDXC card slot
- HDMI port (supports up to 8K at 60Hz or 4K at 240Hz)
- 3.5 mm headphone jack (with advanced support for high-impedance headphones)
- MagSafe 3 port
- Three Thunderbolt 4 (USB-C) ports with support for:
  • Charging
  • DisplayPort
  • Thunderbolt 4 (up to 40Gb/s)
  • USB 4 (up to 40Gb/s)

8. Display Support
- M3 Pro: Up to two external displays with up to 6K resolution at 60Hz over Thunderbolt, or one display up to 6K at 60Hz over Thunderbolt and one up to 4K at 144Hz over HDMI; or one display up to 8K at 60Hz / 4K at 240Hz over HDMI
- M3 Max: Up to four external displays (three up to 6K at 60Hz over Thunderbolt and one up to 4K at 144Hz over HDMI), or up to three external displays (two up to 6K at 60Hz over Thunderbolt and one up to 8K at 60Hz / 4K at 240Hz over HDMI)

9. Wireless
- Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax)
- Bluetooth 5.3

10. Camera and Audio
- 1080p FaceTime HD camera with advanced image signal processor
- High-fidelity six-speaker sound system with force-cancelling woofers
- Wide stereo sound and Spatial Audio support
- Studio-quality three-mic array with high signal-to-noise ratio and directional beamforming
- Multichannel audio output over HDMI

11. Keyboard and Trackpad
- Backlit Magic Keyboard with Touch ID, ambient light sensor, and full-height function keys
- Force Touch trackpad with pressure-sensing and Multi-Touch gestures

12. Dimensions and Weight
- Height: 0.66 inch (1.68 cm)
- Width: 14.01 inches (35.57 cm)
- Depth: 9.77 inches (24.81 cm)
- Weight (M3 Pro): 4.7 pounds (2.14 kg)
- Weight (M3 Max): 4.8 pounds (2.16 kg)
